name: Kagurazaka Nina
source:
Nina married after a fiery love affair with a full-time housewife from a middle-class family, but as the years went by, Nah's feelings for Hina gradually cooled off.

One day, after a long period of sexless days, Nina is hears about Ichika doing pornography and instantly gives in to the desire to join, and exhausts all her pent up sexual desire.
